name: svg_tidy
description: Browser-native SVG optimization and cleanup. Minify SVG, optimize path precision, fix viewBox, convert to data URI. All in WASM.

tools.name: svg_tidy_minify
tools.description: Minify SVG content: remove comments, whitespace, metadata, and editor-specific attributes.

svg.description: Raw SVG content as a string.

tools.name: svg_tidy_optimize_paths
tools.description: Reduce the decimal precision of path coordinates in an SVG.

precision.description: Number of decimal places to keep for path coordinates (0-6).

tools.name: svg_tidy_full_optimize
tools.description: Run the full optimization pipeline: minification, path optimization, viewBox fix, and empty group removal. Returns optimized SVG and stats.

precision.description: Number of decimal places for path coordinates (0-6).

tools.name: svg_tidy_analyze
tools.description: Analyze SVG content to extract metadata (dimensions, element counts) and security information (scripts, external references).

tools.name: svg_tidy_to_data_uri
tools.description: Convert SVG content to a data:image/svg+xml URI suitable for inline use in HTML or CSS.

svg.description: SVG content (can be raw or already optimized).
